findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment, leaving you without leverage or ownership if payment is withheld.
findings.suggested_change: Intellectual property rights in the Deliverables will transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have one small point I would like to adjust before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause about intellectual property, ownership currently passes immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment. I suggest updating this so that intellectual property rights transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services. Please let me know if this adjustment works for you. Best regards,
